facts.text: WebotsCircuit2cPionner3atCameraNnEnv is defined in the pioneer package and extends webots_env.WebotsEnv.
The package registers the environment id WebotsCircuit2cPioneerCameraNnEnv-v0.
The registered entry point is gym_webots.envs.pioneer:WebotsCircuit2cPionner3atCameraNnEnv.
WebotsEnv subclasses gym.Env.
WebotsEnv.__init__ starts roscore and Webots with subprocess.Popen and initializes a ROS node named gym.
A relative world file is resolved under gym_webots/envs/assets/worlds.
The pioneer environment passes pioneer3at-circle.wbt to WebotsEnv.
The environment holds the wheel motor names front_left_wheel, front_right_wheel, back_left_wheel and back_right_wheel.
The environment creates ROS service proxies for simulation_reset, robot/time_step, simulation_set_mode, camera/enable and Sick_LMS_291/enable.
For every wheel the environment creates set_velocity and set_position service proxies of type set_float.
The environment switches Webots to run mode by calling the simulation_set_mode proxy with 1.
The basic time step is read from the robot/get_basic_time_step service and stored in TIME_STEP.
The camera observation parameters are img_rows 32, img_cols 32 and img_channels 1.
calculate_observation marks done when a LaserScan range is greater than 0 and less than 0.21.
enable_sensors calls the camera and lidar enable proxies with TIME_STEP.
enable_motors calls every set_position proxy with float infinity.
stop_robot calls every set_velocity proxy with 0.

step implements three actions: 0 forward, 1 right and 2 left; forward calls all four velocity proxies with 6, a right turn calls the left wheels with 6 and the right wheels with 0.3, and a left turn calls the left wheels with 0.3 and the right wheels with 6.

step does not advance the simulation itself: the step_sim call is commented out and step waits for a LaserScan on /pioneer3at/Sick_LMS_291/laser_scan/layer0 and a camera Image on /pioneer3at/camera/image with a timeout of 5 seconds.
step updates a 50-entry last50actions history with 0 for forward and 1 otherwise.
The reward is computed from left and right sums of the LaserScan ranges and a center-detour term, and is -1 when the observation marks done.
step converts the camera frame to grayscale, resizes it to img_rows by img_cols, reshapes it to (1, 1, rows, cols) and returns (state, reward, done, {}).
reset calls the simulation_reset proxy with 1, sleeps 1 second, then enables the sensors, stops the robot and enables the motors.
reset returns the resized camera state alone, not an observation/info pair.

determinism.notes: the fake is deterministic given its reset seed; the seed changes a placeholder lane offset. Upstream seeds gym.utils.seeding.np_random in _seed(), but its camera and LaserScan stream comes from Webots, so the fake trajectory is not the upstream stream.

gaps: the fake is a pure-Python stand-in: it does not launch roscore or Webots, does not import rospy, cv2 or skimage, and exchanges no ROS topics or services

the real observation is a grayscale camera frame resized to 32 x 32 and reshaped to (1, 1, 32, 32); the fake synthesizes a 32 x 32 pattern of placeholder pixels, so its values and scene content are not renderings

wheel commands, laser ranges, collision detection and reward are analytic placeholders; the fake does not model the Webots pioneer3at wheels, the Sick LMS 291 scan, the 0.21 collision test or the laser-window reward

the upstream class defines no action_space or observation_space; the fake declares Discrete(3) from the three actions implemented in step and Box(0..255) at the real frame shape, both as placeholders. No action_space_ref is set because no upstream line defines the space

the Webots basic time step is read at run time from /pioneer3at/robot/get_basic_time_step (webots_circuit2c_pioneer_camera_nn.py:62-65); the fake declares timestep_ms 0 and does not pace or step the Webots engine
the upstream step returns a legacy gym 4-tuple and reset returns a bare state; the bridge accepts both, and the fake mirrors that shape
the upstream reward slices LaserScan lists with laser_len/5 and laser_len/10 (webots_circuit2c_pioneer_camera_nn.py:197-198), which are float indices under Python 3; the fake does not run that code
no real Webots, ROS or gym/gymnasium run is claimed; gate evidence stays contract_checked (F0)

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: The simulated world stops advancing: after an e-stop the runtime refuses step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last observation stays readable.
